nodes.name: ElevenLabs Webhook
nodes.notes: ElevenLabs calls this webhook with the transcribed voice text from the blind user. Expected body: { "text": "go to page 45", "session_id": "abc123" }

nodes.name: Claude Haiku — Intent Classifier
nodes.notes: Calls Anthropic API directly with claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Add your Anthropic API key as a Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic API Key'. Returns JSON with intent + parameters.

nodes.name: Parse Intent JSON
nodes.notes: Safely parses Claude's JSON response. Falls back to 'unknown' intent if parsing fails. Also carries session_id forward for stateful conversations.

nodes.name: Switch — Route by Intent
nodes.notes: Routes to one of 5 branches: navigate_page, find_book, read_aloud, answer_question, control. Fallback (unknown) goes to extra output.

nodes.name: FastAPI — /detect-page
nodes.notes: Calls your FastAPI /detect-page endpoint. Expected response: { current_page: 12, target_page: 45, direction: 'forward' | 'backward' | 'found' }

nodes.name: Claude — Navigate Guidance
nodes.notes: Generates a 1-sentence spoken navigation instruction based on current vs target page.

nodes.name: FastAPI — /find-book
nodes.notes: Calls your FastAPI /find-book endpoint. Expected response: { found: true, title: 'Harry Potter', location: 'Shelf 2, 3rd from left' } or { found: false }

nodes.name: Claude — Find Book Response
nodes.notes: Converts the /find-book API response into a natural spoken sentence for the blind user.

nodes.name: FastAPI — /ocr-text (read)
nodes.notes: Gets current page OCR text from FastAPI. Expected response: { text: 'The extracted page text here...', page_number: 12 }

nodes.name: Claude — Clean and Read Text
nodes.notes: Cleans OCR noise and returns clean text for ElevenLabs TTS to speak aloud.

nodes.name: FastAPI — /ocr-text (Q&A)
nodes.notes: Gets current page OCR text to use as context for answering the user's question.

nodes.name: Claude — Answer Question
nodes.notes: Uses current page OCR text as context to answer the user's question about the book.

nodes.name: Control Command Handler
nodes.notes: Handles pause/resume/stop/repeat without calling LLM — instant response, no latency.

nodes.name: Merge — Extract Response Text
nodes.notes: Collects the text output from whichever branch ran and normalizes it into { response_text: '...' } for the TTS node.

nodes.name: ElevenLabs TTS
nodes.notes: Converts response text to speech using ElevenLabs. Voice ID '21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM' is Rachel (calm, clear). Change voice ID to any ElevenLabs voice you prefer.

nodes.name: Respond to ElevenLabs
nodes.notes: Returns the response text back to ElevenLabs. ElevenLabs uses this to speak the response to the user. If you're using ElevenLabs-orchestrated mode, return just { text: '...' }.

nodes.name: Unknown Intent Fallback
nodes.notes: Handles unknown or unclassified intents gracefully.
